cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

mechanism: A manages cancellation chores and adapts the phone task so B takes the painful first step without A having to explain the emotional weight.
confusable: Unlike simply delegating logistics, A avoids the why-question and needs B to speak the final no; borrowed authority holds the practical sequence together while depending on B help.
comparison: Anniversary cancellation and putting glasses away differ from receiving an emotionally difficult letter one line at a time.
seedUse: Use D97-a restaurant number/cancel/no new date/glasses and S02-a flexible task allocation; clarify A booking rather than assuming B shares the anniversary.
